description: This Java interface defines methods for retrieving the status and health information of a cluster in an asynchronous manner using CompletionStage. It serves as a contract for implementations that manage and provide cluster health metrics.

classes.name: StatusAndHealthProvider
classes.description: An interface for retrieving cluster status and health information asynchronously.

methods.name: retrieveStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current status information as a JsonObject.

methods.name: retrieveHealth
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current health information as a StatusInfo object.
